purpose: Visual and UX reference for OPD1 Tracker. Stack, API contracts, and repository architecture remain governed by AGENTS.md and the source.

ui.fontFamily: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
ui.usage: Readable system UI; 17px player names, 14px rank, 20px primary metric, 17px secondary metrics, 12px metadata, 11px compact metric labels. Use tabular numerals.

outcome_score.fontFamily: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
outcome_score.usage: Tabular numerals for scores and telemetry.

ascii.usage: ASCII Studio content and controls only.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use border-edge; stronger borders for focused surfaces.
visual_enhancers.translucency: Opaque neutral surfaces. Player Card artwork may use subdued opacity; no OS transparency.

component_guidance.list_rows: Two side-by-side teams, each with five aligned horizontal rows. Fit 1200x700; expand proportionally at maximized sizes.
component_guidance.drawer: Right-side 640px drawer, full height, opaque panel, independent body scroll.
component_guidance.modal: Centered opaque match detail modal above the drawer.
component_guidance.outcomes: Keep win, loss, draw, and unresolved distinct. Use OutcomeBadge sizes consistently.
component_guidance.player_names: Use available identity width and Truncate title for long names.
component_guidance.alerts: Subdued neutral streaks; rose threat badges with reasons in tooltips. Preserve actual party and rank colors in small indicators.

accessibility.interactive: Provide visible focus rings, collision-aware overlays, Escape/outside-click closing, and focus restoration.

media.valorant_assets: Load VALORANT imagery only from media.valorant-api.com.
media.fonts: Use installed Windows system fonts; no external font requests.

design_notes_for_agents: Do not change the Flask backend for visual redesign work.
Every interactive element and key informational wrapper must have a data-testid.
Design Mode must remain guarded by import.meta.env.DEV.
Real data only; demo payloads must never be presented as live data.
